summary: Expanded the stock universe around specialty foodservice distribution and route-density logistics. The stronger underfollowed lane is not broadline distribution itself, but specialty distributors and B2B beverage/coffee route operators that sell into restaurants, hospitality, convenience, and institutional foodservice. Reference context is Performance Food Group because it has scaled foodservice, convenience, and specialty distribution assets.
